lines.text: The LORD asks Israel to fear Him, love Him, serve Him with all their heart, and keep His commandments.
Israel's fathers went down to Egypt, seventy in all, and the LORD has made them as numerous as stars.
The LORD made the waters of the Red Sea engulf Egypt's army, and the earth swallowed Dathan and Abiram.
In the land, Israel is to proclaim the blessing on Mount Carmel and the curse on Mount Ebal.
Israel is about to cross the Jabbok to possess the land, and must follow all the statutes and ordinances.
